name: From the Eclipse
source:
On the eve of you and your fiance announcing your engagement, you find out that her family is involved in an illicit deal and she is set to be given to another guy. She is now destined to be taken by a vile noble as his newest concubine. Determined to free her from this unfair future, our hero needs to find allies, and come up with a plan free her. But, as you will find out, things in life never go the way that you may want or plan them to. The law is the law and you must follow it. Because if you don't, you could be the one in trouble next!

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/erochaser]Patreon[/url]]
